scope: Tracked public notebooks present in this worktree; metadata/prose audit, not solver acceptance.

policy.coverage_contract: Citation-free notebooks require a specific operational exemption. Resolved keys establish bibliography integrity, not scientific validation or completeness of the method-to-implementation explanation.

policy.notebook: docs ipynb files should store executed outputs
policy.example_webgui: example notebooks must store executed ngsolve.webgui.Draw or netgen.webgui.Draw rich output
policy.field_webgui: field notebooks must store Draw(field, mesh, name=..., ...) rich output with explicit view arguments
policy.json: computed docs results should have adjacent JSON with generated_at_utc and version/runtime metadata
policy.sync: the JSON must include notebook_sha256 matching the current result-bearing ipynb
policy.tracked_only_default: true; set tracked_only=false for explicit WIP-tree audits

acceptance_limits: Citation resolution does not establish correct scientific attribution or a complete derivation.
Existing saved outputs are not a rerun against current dirty solver sources.
WebGUI metadata gates do not cover notebooks without explicit applicability declarations.
AXIFEM catalog relocation still needs a genuine public result-bearing replacement.
Wakao analytical-formula reports Part 1-9 still need individually verified bibliographic metadata.

live_bibliography_comparison.note: This reads the live-reported source file; it does not prove a process reload.
